scope_statement: Each of bitget-signal's 19 tools is called 3 times, 2.0s apart, with the call a user of its Skill would make (eval/skill_matrix.py), through the same client the desk uses, and classified reliable / intermittent / down; 5 Skills are counted as Skills and the tools no SKILL.md names are listed apart. NOT CLAIMED: that 3 attempts characterise a service — they distinguish always from sometimes from never and nothing finer. NOT CLAIMED: that a failure is Bitget's fault; the failures observed carry the service's own error envelopes, including an explicit ConnectTimeout from its upstream, so the most this says is that the door was shut when we knocked.
